Title: Public Preview: Foundry Local for on-device AI

Body.Content:
Foundry Local makes it easy to run AI models, tools and agents directly on-device, whether Windows 11 or MacOS . Foundry Local includes model inferencing, models, agents as a service, and model playground for fast and efficient local Al development. This new capability brings the power of open-source models in Microsoft Foundry Models to client devices including Windows 11 and MacOS, starting today.
Learn more.
